description: This file is a part of Twig, a templating engine for PHP. It defines the 'IfTokenParser' class responsible for parsing 'if' conditional statements within Twig templates.

classes.name: IfTokenParser
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractTokenParser to handle parsing of 'if' statements in Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an 'if' token, constructs and returns an IfNode representing the parsed conditional block.

methods.name: decideIfFork
methods.description: Determines if the current token signals an 'elseif', 'else', or 'endif' to continue or branch parsing.

methods.name: decideIfEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token signals the end of the 'if' block, i.e., 'endif'.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name this parser handles, which is 'if'.
